line: fst     [esp+arg_1C]; When the target is moving, builds its boot-noise term as bootWeight * fSneakBootWeightMult + fSneakBootWeightBase; stationary targets retain the quiet baseline.
jz      short Calc_DetectionLevel_ApplyCombatBonus; Applies fSneakTargetInCombatBonus when the observed target is in combat.
